title: I drew a digit and 4 ML models voted on it
what: Four classic ML models (SVM, neural net, random forest, k-NN) train on 8x8 digit images, then vote on the number I draw.

title: Two AIs, one cliff: only one plays it safe
what: Q-learning and SARSA learn to cross a cliff by trial and error. One takes the risky edge, the other the safe route.

title: I trained a tiny GPT from scratch on my CPU
what: A character-level transformer (818,176 parameters) goes from gibberish to Shakespeare-like text while training on a CPU.

title: 100 rockets, zero programming: they evolve a route
what: A genetic algorithm evolves rocket steering until they reach the target. I scrub through the generations.

title: I tried to hack an AI guarding a password
what: A prompt-injection lab with five defense levels: the weakest bot leaks the secret, stronger setups hold.

title: What does an AI actually look at? Grad-CAM X-ray
what: A real MobileNetV2 guesses the photo and Grad-CAM paints the pixels that drove its decision.

title: 60 AI birds learn to fly with zero training
what: Sixty tiny neural nets evolve to play a Flappy-style game: the best birds breed, children mutate, and by generation 8 one flies the course.

title: I looked inside a GPT: where does each head look?
what: A tiny GPT reads Shakespeare and every attention head is plotted: in layer 1 one head looks exactly one character back, another exactly two.

title: Watch a neural net learn a spiral, live
what: A numpy neural net learns the spiral dataset while the decision boundary bends. Capacity decides what it can learn.

title: What ChatGPT actually reads (it isn't letters)
what: Text is split into tokens, not letters. The same greeting costs 21 tokens in one vocabulary and 41 in another.

title: K-means cuts this in half. This one doesn't.
what: Same data, four clustering algorithms. Each one assumes a shape, so each wins on different data.

title: Which words made the AI decide? It shows me.
what: A text classifier highlights the words behind each decision, including a tricky sentence that it gets torn on.

title: Can YOU spot the AI lie? 1 of 5 facts is fake
what: GPT writes five facts and one is false. Can you find it? LLMs state falsehoods as confidently as facts.

title: Can you make GPT write exactly 10 words?
what: Prompt Gym grades prompts with strict Python checks. A lazy prompt fails, a specific one passes.

title: I made two AIs debate pineapple on pizza
what: A pro bot and a con bot debate, a judge scores them, and I see whether they changed my mind.

title: Two AI prompts fight. A judge picks the winner.
what: Pirate-style vs expert-style prompts battle. A judge scores both answer orders and Elo updates the ranking.

title: I turned 60 sentences into a map of meaning
what: Sentences become points on a map, and a question retrieves the closest ones for a RAG answer.

title: Can GPT read my mind in 20 questions?
what: GPT asks yes/no questions to narrow down what I am thinking of while the counter drops.
